newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Thermo Electron rated strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Thermo Electron rated strong buy.

text.p: -- Barrington Research analyst Michael Hutchison said he raised his rating on Thermo Electron Corp to strong buy from buy.
-- Hutchison said he took the action Tuesday based on the company's share price. Thermo Electron shares were up 1/4 at 29 at midday Wednesday, near their 52-week low of 28-1/2.

-- "Obviously, the recent overall sell-off in the stock market has impacted this stock, although we believe the weak relative price action of Thermo Electron and its 19 public subsidiaries reflects the general underperformance by small-cap issues, especially technology stocks," Hutchison said.

-- While the price of Thermo Electron has declined to reflect the sell-off in all of its publicly traded subsidiaries, the discount to the holding value of the subsidiaries has increased to 13 percent, higher than the typical five to 10 percent, he said.
